edges.description: Architecture is the deep composition mission/ownership map; it remains a specification rather than a runtime coordinator.
Composition invariants define the current cross-domain preservation taxonomy and should be checked before adding new laws.
The provenance matrix records exact source origin/status and reconciliation triggers so imported rules do not silently gain authority.
The threat model catalogs cross-domain semantic failure modes without creating a security/runtime authority layer.
Conformance scenarios challenge the composition specification; scenario success is not production or semantic approval.
The future-work ledger preserves unresolved questions and reopen triggers but does not itself select or authorize implementation.
The matrix pins composition-relevant Native Kernel semantics with source status and reconciliation triggers; inherited material does not transfer Native authority to Mentaury-Kernel.
The matrix pins selected Soul provenance/self-attribution semantics while preserving Soul as the owning cognition/identity authority.
Composition freshness, restore and migration boundaries overlap Continuum process-continuity concerns, but composition preservation is not process continuity ownership.
The AI entry point defines Continuum read order and authority routing so current state, protocol, evidence and history are not conflated.
The audit/future-work ledger preserves unresolved work and historical checkpoints; current machine state must be checked before acting on it.
Experiment 0 preregistration defines the allowed bounded experiment semantics before evidence collection and is not itself empirical support.
The human-reference approval closes only the human semantic-reference dependency and explicitly does not authorize Pilot, Evidence Lock or production.
Approved capture gold is the human-approved Experiment 0 reference material, separated from AI-proposed candidate drafts.
Approved transfer oracle is the human-approved Experiment 0 reference material, separated from AI-proposed candidate drafts.
The approval record binds the reviewed decision/provenance to the approved capture reference bytes within the human-reference gate only.
The approval record binds the reviewed decision/provenance to the approved transfer oracle bytes within the human-reference gate only.
State Validation Lab may test continuity/state claims, while the Continuum preregistration owns Experiment 0 semantics; laboratory evidence does not rewrite the protocol.
The CLOS ecosystem crosswalk routes research consequences to existing project owners and explicitly prevents CLOS from becoming a seventh sovereign authority.
Reach/use measurement decomposes retrieved→serialized→transmitted→used→answer-supporting stages so trace membership is not mistaken for semantic use.
The F2 checkpoint records the later-task reopen evidence ceiling after Titan #436: bounded capability exists, full query/answer-path behavior does not.
F3 preserves evidence that the same outward stop can have different material bases without authorizing a universal StopReason primitive.
The Athene source manifest keeps external research provenance explicit before any comparative use or crosswalk.
The Athene crosswalk compares donor material with Velantrim concepts while preserving donor status and non-promotion boundaries.
F2 evidence was localized through bounded Titan owner-local reopen planning/execution work; CLOS research does not transfer runtime authority into or out of Titan.
F3 used several bounded Titan owner-local paths to observe distinct stop bases; this supports a phenomenon, not a universal Titan or CLOS stop architecture.
CLOS routes only cross-domain composition consequences to Mentaury-Kernel after evidence and owner fit; research similarity does not transfer ownership.
CLOS routes process-continuity/currentness consequences to Continuum only when a concrete owner-local obligation survives crosswalk.
CLOS routes stable substrate-neutral semantic obligations to Native Kernel only after bounded evidence and explicit owner acceptance.
